summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, chmods it executable, and uses it to execFileSync a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotated string-array obfuscator (function WV8StW rotating a large const array n7gIxM) and no readable code. setup.mjs itself is variable-name-obfuscated with hex-suffixed identifiers despite performing only download-and-exec logic. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload at install time is unrelated to a chatbot-client library's stated purpose, and running the payload under Bun rather than the ambient Node evades Node-based inspection. The static ping-command patterns observed in dist/api/service-clients.js and src/api/service-clients.ts are consistent with the same install-time execution surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
